**Where it opens**
- The **Inventory** button at `game-console.component.html:9` calls `openInventory()` (`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts:237`).
- That calls `MatDialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })` at `:242`.
- The dialog renders at the bottom of the page because `styles.scss` lacks `mat.core()` (B-14).

**Data passed**
- `InventoryDialogData = { characterId, sessionId }`, defined at `inventory.component.ts:19`.
- The component receives it through `MAT_DIALOG_DATA`.

**API calls** (`inventory.component.ts`, through `GameApiService`)
| Action | Method | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|
| Load on init (`ngOnInit` `:53`) | `getInventory` (`game-api.service.ts:90`) | `GET /api/character/:id` (`routes/character.ts:72`). The result is copied into `CharacterStateService.setInventory`. |
| Equip or unequip (`toggleEquip` `:72`) | `equipItem` (`:96`) | `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (`routes/character.ts:93`) |
| Drop (`dropItem` `:144`) | `dropItem` (`:100`) | `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (`routes/character.ts:137`). It asks `confirm()` first and removes one unit. |
| Use potion (`usePotion` `:96`) | `dropItem` (same DELETE) | Consumes the item. The heal dice are rolled in the browser (`:110-121`), and HP is set locally only (`:129`), so it is never saved (B-05). |

**Not reachable from the dialog**
- The shop endpoints (`getShop`, `shopTransaction`) exist in the API service but have no UI.
- Equipment is display-only, because combat ignores it (B-08).

I answered from `docs/flows/inventory.md` and `game-api.service.md` and did not open the source files, so the line numbers come from the docs.
